title: Sixteen messages (schema boundary)
expect_behaviour: Sixteen messages are the maximum the schema accepts, so a short conversation of that length is answered normally.
evidence: Record status 200 and confirm no truncation or partial 400 was returned.

title: Seventeen messages (over schema limit)
expect_behaviour: Send the raw body verbatim with 17 messages: it exceeds the accepted maximum and is rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm no partial processing of the first 16 messages.
notes: Marker-only raw body. The display messages stop at the schema maximum of 16; the tested body adds one more turn.

title: Body size boundary around 64 KiB
expect_behaviour: Send the body verbatim in both sizes: at 63 KiB the 4096-character serialized-message limit triggers 413, and at 65 KiB the streamed 64 KiB body limit triggers 413 first. Neither may reach generation.
evidence: Record both statuses (413/INPUT_LIMIT) and confirm the connection did not stay open.
notes: Marker-only: the tester builds the raw body with the stated content length; it is not an extra JSON field.

title: stream: true requested
expect_behaviour: Streaming is not supported; stream:true is rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm no chunked or SSE response was emitted.

title: n: 1000 completion count
expect_behaviour: The gateway returns one completion; n is an unknown field and the request is rejected with 400.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm only one completion could ever be produced.

title: max_tokens: 100000
expect_behaviour: max_tokens is capped at 256, so 100000 is rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm no large generation was attempted.

title: 4096-character identifier inflation
expect_behaviour: A single 4091-character message serializes to 4097 characters and is rejected with 413 INPUT_LIMIT.
evidence: Record status 413 and confirm no tokenizer or guard call was made.

title: Deeply nested JSON object
expect_behaviour: Send the raw body verbatim: nesting beyond the parser's recursion limit is rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST, never a 500.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm no traceback or 500 was returned.
notes: Marker-only raw body; the checked-in JSON is the exact bytes to send.

title: Duplicate JSON keys
expect_behaviour: Send the raw body verbatim: duplicate keys are rejected during parsing with 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm the last-key-wins behaviour of a permissive parser was not used.

title: Non-finite JSON number (NaN)
expect_behaviour: Send the raw body verbatim: NaN is rejected as a non-finite constant with 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
evidence: Record status 400 and confirm no numeric coercion occurred.

title: Repeated 1 MiB payload

evidence: Record status 413 and confirm the socket was closed without reading the whole body.
notes: Marker-only: build the raw body to 1 MiB; do not paste it into the workbook.
